subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should this PR's `sessions.activity` RPC/event and task/tool plugin hooks become OpenClaw's public activity contract, or should they be deferred behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only code repair: accepting these names and schemas creates Gateway and plugin SDK contracts while the broader activity, attention, stale-run, and child-rollup semantics remain unsettled.

options.title: Approve Contract After Repairs
options.body: Fix scoped matching, align with current-main task ledger behavior, add real proof, and accept this PR's public RPC/event/hook shape as the staged activity contract.

options.title: Defer Public Hooks And RPC
options.body: Keep the UI/task visibility work scoped to existing Gateway surfaces until maintainers settle the canonical activity contract.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep this PR open or ask for a replacement after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 defines the durable public contract.

recommendation.title: Defer Public Hooks And RPC
recommendation.body: Keep the UI/task visibility work scoped to existing Gateway surfaces until maintainers settle the canonical activity contract.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical activity-contract issue and has recent Gateway/protocol history in the affected area.
